body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

QA run record, run on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「然后 studio 相关的功能再完整的测试一下」; filing: 「发记录并立卡」. The record is text only.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `main` at `3482f3d8d2`. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm console:build`. The console is this tree's own build, served at `/_console`.
- Four runners in parallel, each with its own showcase boot, port (3791–3794), file database and `OS_HOME`, in tabs of the desktop app's built-in browser pane.
- Personas: the seeded admin; members made per item.
- **Isolation.** Session cookies ignore ports, so runners on `localhost` overwrote each other's cookie until this was found mid-run. Runners then moved to `rN.localhost` and re-drove every fail and gate-related reading there. Two artefacts were discarded that way. Some passes ran before isolation with a bearer identity; each runner's detail names which.
- Not run: the `ui/e2e/live` specs, which need the console dev server. Those items were driven by hand.

## Scope

All 42 active items of `area:studio-authoring` not judged an hour earlier, plus `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale` and `access-security.readonly-package-locks-studio`.

Carried-forward: #29648 · studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display · FAIL
